name: Thunder-Coil Basin
core_rationale: Eastern lightning-inductor basin of Continent 02 where Krono the Brass Titan's copper fingers grounded atmospheric storms into a ring of humming Leyden-jar towers.
local_conflict: Arc-charged copper automatons and storm-elementals surge along the inductor rails whenever the Steppe gales peak.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Glider couriers say that flying within a league of Thunder-Coil Basin makes every brass button on your coat hum in three-part harmony.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Five colossal glass-and-copper Leyden-jar towers joined by harmless blue corona arcs above the eastern steppe.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What ancient dynamo beneath Thunder-Coil Basin is still drawing power from Krono's grounded fingers?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-krono-brass-titan and scar-brass-faultline along the eastern storm-inductor rim of Continent 02.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Colossal glass-and-copper Leyden-jar towers linked by singing blue corona arcs across the copper steppe.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: rubber-insulated catwalk and Faraday-cage doorway metrics for 1.05m characters will be verified upon promotion to Draft.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: reserved as the eastern storm-inductor District frontier on Continent 02 with zero filler maps.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Provides complete mystery_hook (in_world_rumor, visual_silhouette, unanswered_question) and empty grid_nodes.
